tools.name: validate_npi
tools.description: Offline check of up to 50 NPI numbers: 10 digits and the Luhn check digit (prefix 80840). Does not call CMS, so it cannot say whether the number is issued; use lookup_npi for that.

tools.name: lookup_npi
tools.description: Fetch 1-20 providers by NPI number from the live CMS NPI Registry: name, credential, status, primary specialty (taxonomy), practice address and phone. Check digits are validated first; invalid and unknown numbers are reported separately.

tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Search the live NPI Registry by first/last name, organization name, specialty (taxonomy description as the registry writes it, e.g. "Family Medicine", "Dentist"), state (2 letters), city or ZIP. tools.name: count_by_specialty
tools.description: How many providers does the NPI Registry list for a specialty, optionally in a state or ZIP prefix? Exact up to 1,200; beyond that it says "1200+" and points to the full-list route. Up to 5 specialties per call.
